acceptance_contract: Answer every part of each of the three controller questions from the supplied excerpt.
Do not attempt to cover material that no controller question asks about.
Keep each answer at or below 120 words, excluding copied supporting snippets.
Use one or two short exact supporting snippets per answer; every snippet must be copied from the excerpt and be at most 350 characters.
State an explicit source-unknown caveat for each answer whenever the excerpt leaves dependency, runtime, threat-model, or deployment behavior unresolved.
Return exactly the three fixed question IDs in JSON. Schema validity alone is not evidence of answer quality.
